closedFindings.title: Public UI gate does not enforce promised complete maintenance attribution
closedFindings.finding: The public UI gate activated complete maintenance attribution only after a gate-control path changed. It missed unreviewed taskctl-only controls, later maintenance-note changes and unrelated delivery, although task submission rejected them.
closedFindings.closure: The public UI gate, including its no-net-UI branch, and taskctl now share corrective_scope_errors and corrective_path_admitted. The full original-base-to-candidate history must attribute every out-of-scope commit to an exact independently reviewed control-only chain. Reviewed filenames do not authorize later edits. The new public-gate regressions and the fresh selected suite pass.

notes: This accepts only the bounded five-file control-maintenance increment at the reviewed final candidate. It does not retrospectively accept the adverse first candidate. Its 43-test run had 42 passes and one diagnostic-wording failure; the inherited review-obligation assertion remains intact and passes at the final candidate.

Independently reviewed both exact source commits. Their complete ordered inventories, sole-parent edges, regular Git blobs and SHA-256 values authenticate against Git. The final reviewedArtifacts inventory is the union of every path touched by those commits, bound at the final candidate. Evidence delivery is the immediate sole-parent evidence-only commit. The review-only delivery is still to be committed.

The optional identical sourceCommits inventories preserve the adverse source history without reset or invented earlier acceptance. Every intermediate source commit remains linear and control-only. Omissions, reordering, substituted hashes, incomplete intermediate or final inventories, mismatched carriers, hidden product-and-revert history and merged source history are denied. Existing absent-field single-source behavior and immediate evidence/review-only delivery requirements remain strict.

The amendment-origin route consumes existing authenticated named approval, packet, immutable original task and approved-reference contract authority. It does not fabricate an ordinary review_gate, edit immutable origin metadata, waive current correction conformance, or change the six admitted W1.C04.T01 product/test paths. Ordinary unsupported origins and authority substitutions remain denied.

Read the actual fresh receipt and three logs; their hashes, exact candidate, producer and containment-helper identities match the evidence. The selected suite reports 45 tests passing in 229.126 seconds (owned wrapper 230.51681339996867 seconds); Ruff lint and format checks pass. All three recorded groups exit zero with zero active processes and EMPTY_CONFIRMED drainage. The first candidate's failed receipt and log also authenticate and remain adverse.

The live public UI gate has not yet been run on this committed review delivery. Acceptance here does not claim that live gate passed, W1.C04.T01 task completion, product/native qualification, installed-runtime evidence reuse, full Wave qualification, integration or release approval. The protected W1.A04.B00 witness was not opened, hashed, copied or modified by this review.
